recovered_family.chronology_boundary: copy-number suffixes are not admissible chronology evidence

historical_tachyon_predictor.neighbor_rule: use scores whose config lr differs from query lr by less than 0.005
historical_tachyon_predictor.fallback: mean score of most recent 20 observations
historical_tachyon_predictor.claim_boundary: this is a local empirical score estimator, not future-information access and not a probability of improvement

reasons: SimpleBayesianOptimizer is not a Bayesian surrogate/acquisition implementation
relay_step does not call bayes.tell, so the optimizer is not actually updated there
cobble_generator mutates a clone and then calls __init__, reinitializing model state and erasing the mutation before use
piston_push deletes the weakest active agent, conflicting with NO_LEARNING_ENTITY_DELETION
UI describes Tachyon output as percent improvement although predict returns an empirical mean score

modern_repairs: insufficient history returns no estimate instead of magic 0.5
estimate is descriptive only and requires prospective scoring

absorbed_tower_features: champion/best-state preservation already exists in later MicroForge and JANUS evolution lineages
mutation/evolution concepts already exist elsewhere and Tower's destructive/erasing implementation is not reused
two-step metric trend forecasting is already restored separately from genesis_protocol TachyonField
